subject: general
question: Which of the following has four chambered heart?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peacock.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Peacock has a** four-chambered** heart.
 
• Peacock is the **national bird** of** India** and its **scientific name** is *Pavo cristatus.*
 
• Taxonomy of Peacock:
 
 
• Kingdom: Animalia
 
• Phylum: Chordata
 
• Subphylum: Vertebrata 
 
• Superclass: Tetrapoda 
 
• Class: Aves 
 
• Order: Galliformes
 
• Family: Phasianidae
 
• Genus: Pavo
 
• Species: cristatus
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **frog** belongs to the class **Amphibia** and has a characteristic** three-chambered heart** with **2 auricles and 1 ventricle.**
 
• **Fishes **have a **two-chambered heart. **
 
• **Sea horses **have a **two-chambered heart**
